test_title: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 21 Jun, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: At what rate (in percentage) per annum will ₹1,300 give ₹650 as simple interest in 10 years?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

**Simple Interest (SI)** per year = 650 ÷ 10 = ₹65

**Rate** % = (Interest for 1 year ÷ Principal) × 100

**Rate** = (65 ÷ 1300) × 100

**Rate** = 5%

**∴ The correct answer is 5%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Principal (P)** = ₹1,300

**Simple Interest (SI)** = ₹650

**Time (T)** = 10 years

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7e26d5e13d8bee6a03b57e6905cc07e94fabf06512a79b1a5de4821d1964ec66.png] 

**Formula Used:**

SI = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

**Calculations:**

⇒ 650 = (1300 × R × 10) ÷ 100

⇒ 650 = (13000 × R) ÷ 100

⇒ 650 = 130 × R

⇒ R = 650 ÷ 130

⇒ R = 5%

**∴ The correct answer is 5%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Simple Interest Concept

Interest is calculated only on the **original principal** amount throughout the entire period. SI = P × R × T / 100.

Total Amount Formula

The final sum of money is called the **Amount**. Amount (A) = Principal (P) + Simple Interest (SI).

Finding Time or Principal

Using the same base formula, **Time (T)** = (SI × 100) ÷ (P × R) and **Principal (P)** = (SI × 100) ÷ (R × T).
